Make content - be creative 

Here’s the story I did that video on Winelibrary TV showing that you could taste different things to build your Wine pallet. How are you gonna taste the earthy tones in red burgundy if you didn’t have a little dirt … how are you gonna be able to taste cassis  if you’ve never had cassis  before and so on and so on … that video went viral on digg.com and other important sites of the time that led to the producers of Conan OBrien at the height of Conan OBrien to see me and book me on the show … that was super rare at the time because the Internet wasn’t what it was today today so many of you have the same opportunities with a little creativity and a little courage
